CodingTaskContract.description: Immutable requested work. String bounds are additionally enforced in UTF-8 bytes by admission. Paths must be normalized repository-relative paths; dependencies name previously accepted revisions owned by this operator. Repository identity is a selector, not a grant to access it.

ConversationMessage.description: Assistant authorship requires a validated native outcome.

ConversationMessagePayload.description: Payload for conversation_message at the common command ingress. Cursor is required and nullable; null starts a thread. Content is preserved exactly and additionally limited to 32768 UTF-8 bytes. Whitespace-only messages and controls other than tab and newline are rejected.

EffectRow.description: First-slice effect row with its stored receipt kind.

attempt_state.description: Linked attempt state; null is a linkage contradiction.

authority_time.description: Store clock read inside the snapshot.

GateOutcome.description: Spec 22.3 outcome catalog. Only PASS satisfies a requirement.

JsonValue.description: A recursively typed JSON value from durable command truth.

LabelCount.description: One catalog label with its row count; zero is explicit, never absent.

LeaseLiveness.description: Judged against the store clock inside the same snapshot.
